roles.title: Signal scout
roles.impact: Find local AI movement before it disappears into disconnected feeds.
roles.firstAction: Submit one sourced Kentucky AI signal with region, date, and why it matters.

roles.title: Source reviewer
roles.impact: Keep KYAI trusted enough for schools, cities, chambers, and journalists.
roles.firstAction: Verify five links for date, region, people, institution, and status.

roles.title: Toolkit builder
roles.impact: Turn the pulse into useful artifacts people can apply the same day.
roles.firstAction: Improve one checklist for a school, library, small business, or civic group.

roles.title: Workshop host
roles.impact: Bring AI literacy into real rooms across Kentucky.
roles.firstAction: Offer a location, audience, and preferred month for a practical AI session.

roles.title: Profile maintainer
roles.impact: Make Kentucky's AI network discoverable instead of invisible.
roles.firstAction: Add or correct one person, organization, program, or local host profile.

roles.title: Developer
roles.focus: Site, automation, data validation, search, APIs
roles.impact: Make contribution intake, review, publishing, and sharing easier every week.
roles.firstAction: Claim a scoped issue and keep the pull request small enough to review.

roles.title: Designer
roles.focus: Share cards, maps, decks, accessibility, visual polish
roles.impact: Make Kentucky AI work feel credible, modern, and worth passing around.
roles.firstAction: Improve one share asset, regional card, toolkit layout, or mobile interaction.

roles.title: Editor
roles.impact: Protect trust while letting the community submit widely.
roles.firstAction: Review three submitted signals against the editorial checklist.

missions.title: Map every Kentucky AI degree, certificate, and course cluster
missions.needed: Education signal scouts and source reviewers
missions.outcome: A verified education pipeline page KYAI can update each semester.

missions.title: Find the next 30 days of Kentucky AI events
missions.outcome: A living event rail people can actually plan around.

missions.title: Verify the data-center policy and infrastructure watchlist
missions.needed: Policy readers, local government watchers, source reviewers
missions.outcome: Clear source-backed explainers on energy, taxes, jobs, and local impact.

missions.title: Build the public library AI basics deck
missions.outcome: A 45-minute deck any Kentucky library can run.

missions.title: Add 25 Kentucky people and organizations building with AI
missions.outcome: A network directory people can claim, correct, and share.

missions.title: Draft the Louisville AI ecosystem brief
missions.outcome: A shareable city page with signals, events, people, and open asks.

pipeline.description: Community idea, lead, profile, or toolkit request arrives through GitHub issue forms.
Editors check source URL, date, region, category, people, and relevance.
Signal has enough source backing to enter the next public build.
Signal, profile, event, toolkit, or mission is live and shareable.

badges.name: Founding contributor
badges.description: Help publish, review, or host one of the first KYAI community contributions.

badges.name: Regional maintainer
badges.description: Keep one Kentucky region's signals, events, people, and open asks current.

badges.name: Verified source reviewer
badges.description: Review submitted links and corrections against the editorial policy.

badges.name: Workshop host
badges.description: Offer a real room, audience, or partner channel for practical AI education.
